# technitium_record_naptr (Resource)

Manages a single `NAPTR` record in an authoritative zone.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The record's domain name, for example `www.example.com`. Use the zone name for a record at the zone apex.
- `naptr_order` (Number) The order in which the `NAPTR` records must be processed, lowest first.
- `naptr_preference` (Number) The order in which `NAPTR` records with the same `naptr_order` should be processed, lowest first.
- `zone` (String) The authoritative zone that holds the record.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Comments stored with the record.
- `disable` (Boolean) Disable the record without deleting it. Defaults to `false`.
- `expiry_ttl` (Number) Deletes the record automatically this many seconds after it was last modified. Terraform then creates it again on the next apply.
- `naptr_flags` (String) The flags that control how the other fields are interpreted, for example `U`, `S`, `A` or `P`.
- `naptr_regexp` (String) The substitution expression applied to the string the client holds to build the next domain name or URI.
- `naptr_replacement` (String) The next domain name to query, when `naptr_regexp` is not used.
- `naptr_services` (String) The services available down this rewrite path, for example `E2U+sip`.
- `ttl` (Number) The record TTL in seconds. Defaults to the default record TTL in the server settings.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.
